x-groups.title: AWS
x-groups.description: Without access keys, the AWS SDK's default credentials, such as a role the runner assumes for the connector.

region.title: Region
region.description: The streams' AWS region. Default: the AWS default config's.

accessKeyId.title: Access key ID
accessKeyId.description: An AWS access key. Without one, the AWS default credentials.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: A Kinesis-compatible endpoint: an emulator's, or a VPC endpoint.

schemaRegistryUrl.title: Registry URL
schemaRegistryUrl.description: A Confluent-compatible schema registry. Avro and Protobuf need one.

schemaRegistryUsername.title: Registry username
schemaRegistryUsername.description: A user for the schema registry's basic authentication. Unset: none.

oneOf.title: JSON
oneOf.description: JSON data, whose columns and types come from the records.

oneOf.title: Avro
oneOf.description: The schema registry's Avro wire format.

oneOf.title: Protobuf
oneOf.description: The schema registry's Protobuf wire format.

oneOf.title: String
oneOf.description: Each record's data as text, into the column value.

streams.title: Streams
streams.description: The Kinesis streams to offer as streams. Empty: every stream the credentials can list.

streamPattern.title: Stream pattern
streamPattern.description: A regular expression streams must match to be offered.

startPosition.title: Start position
startPosition.description: Where a shard's first read starts.

oneOf.title: Latest
oneOf.description: Records that arrive after the read starts.
